Supported formats:
• https://github.com/org/repo

• https://gitlab.com/org/repo
• https://gitlab.com/org/repo/my-branch
• https://gitlab.com/group/subgroup/repo.git
• https://self-hosted.example.com/org/repo.git

For GitHub and GitLab a .git suffix is optional. For self-hosted instances it is required.
GitLab subgroup repos require the .git suffix.
